title: Abba Elazar
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Chagigah 16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chagigah.16b.16) and at [the beginning of Sifra, Vayikra, section 2](https://www.sefaria.org/Sifra%2C_Vayikra_Dibbura_DeNedavah%2C_Section_2.2): Rabbi Yose said, “Abba Elazar told me”—[Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Chagigah.16b.16.1) explains that this was his name—“once we had a calf for a peace offering,” etc. Hyman infers that he had seen the Temple while it still stood.

notes.text: “While the Temple stood” renders בבניינו. The inference that he saw it is Hyman’s.

The linked Sifra has the parallel story and uses “said to me” where the Bavli has “told me.” [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=561&lang=en) cites both forms and points to Rashi’s gloss that Abba Elazar was his name. The conclusion that he witnessed the Temple while standing is Hyman’s inference.
